race.comment: REFRESHING (11) has the profile to improve again after finishing fourth at Murray Bdge, beaten two and a half lengths, when she gave a sight at generous odds. The rise to 1516m is the one qualification, but she is top-rated over the last 12 months, gets the 1.5kg claim and has beaten BLACK SEA in a recent meeting. EXONUMIA (2) is the obvious danger after a long-neck second at Balaklava and a dominant Class 3 win at Wentworth, where he beat SPICY AMBITION by just under six lengths. He is hard fit, on a quick back-up and has placed at this distance. BLACK SEA (3) was sound first-up at Murray Bdge, closing from well back for fifth, and the Aaron Bain and Ned Taylor stable has a strong record at this track. Include. BORN TO SHINE (12) nearly snapped up a win when second last time. Has claims.
